Class PeeringDbClient

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering.client.PeeringDbClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class PeeringDbClient extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Lightweight HTTP client for the PeeringDB REST API.

Provides access to PeeringDB's network, internet exchange, facility, and organization data with optional API key authentication. Uses Apache HttpClient (the same transport library as the Equinix SDK core) for HTTP communication and Jackson for JSON deserialization.

Equinix-Scoped Data

This client includes built-in support for loading the Equinix organization (org_id=2) with all nested IXes and facilities in a single call via loadEquinixCatalog(). Subsequent per-ASN queries can then be filtered against the cached Equinix IX and facility IDs.

Authentication

PeeringDB allows unauthenticated read access with rate limiting (~20 requests/minute). Providing an API key via the constructor increases rate limits and grants access to contact information fields.

Rate limiting

An HTTP 429 from PeeringDB is retried up to 3 times, honouring the Retry-After response header (seconds or HTTP-date form) and falling back to a small exponential backoff when the header is absent or unparsable. The total time spent waiting for a single logical request is capped at 30000L ms — a Retry-After beyond the remaining budget fails fast instead of stalling the caller. Multi-ASN lookups should prefer the batched collection overloads (getNetworks, getEquinixIxPresence(Collection), getEquinixFacPresence(Collection)), which use PeeringDB's asn__in query operator to collapse N per-ASN requests into one request per endpoint — the single most effective way to stay under the anonymous limit.

Lifecycle

The client owns a CloseableHttpClient and is itself AutoCloseable: whoever constructs a PeeringDbClient owns closing it (the analysis engine never closes a client it was handed). PeeringIntelligence.Builder.analyze() constructs its own client and closes it when the analysis completes.

Usage

try (PeeringDbClient client = new PeeringDbClient("your-api-key")) {
    client.loadEquinixCatalog();

    PeeringDbNetwork aws = client.getNetwork(16509);
    List<PeeringDbNetIxlan> awsIxPresence = client.getEquinixIxPresence(16509);
    List<PeeringDbNetFac> awsFacPresence = client.getEquinixFacPresence(16509);
}

      public static PeeringDbClient withBaseUrl(String apiKey, String baseUrl)
      Creates a PeeringDB client pointed at an alternate API base URL.

      Test seam. This exists so the HTTP/parsing paths can be exercised against a local stub server; production code should use the no-arg or API-key constructors, which target the real PeeringDB endpoint.

      Parameters:
      apiKey - the PeeringDB API key, or null for unauthenticated access
      baseUrl - the API base URL (e.g. http://localhost:PORT/api)
      Returns:
      a client that issues requests against baseUrl

    • loadEquinixCatalog

      public void loadEquinixCatalog() throws IOException
      Loads the complete Equinix organization catalog from PeeringDB, including all internet exchanges (ix_set) and facilities (fac_set).

      This makes a single API call to /api/org/2?depth=2 and caches the results. All subsequent calls to getEquinixIxPresence(long) and getEquinixFacPresence(long) filter against this cached catalog.

      Throws:
      IOException - if the API call fails

    • getNetworks

      public Map<Long, PeeringDbNetwork> getNetworks(Collection<Long> asns) throws IOException
      Retrieves network metadata for multiple ASNs in batched net?asn__in=... requests — one HTTP request per 150 ASNs instead of one per ASN.

      A single-element collection delegates to getNetwork(long) (the plain asn= query), so subclass stubs and per-ASN behaviour stay identical for that case.

      Parameters:
      asns - the autonomous system numbers (duplicates are collapsed)
      Returns:
      map of ASN to network metadata; ASNs PeeringDB does not know are absent from the map
      Throws:
      IOException - if any API call fails

    • getNetIxlans

      public Map<Long, List<PeeringDbNetIxlan>> getEquinixIxPresence(Collection<Long> asns) throws IOException
      Retrieves IX LAN presence records for multiple ASNs, filtered to Equinix IXes only, using batched asn__in requests (one per 150 ASNs instead of one per ASN).

      A single-element collection delegates to getEquinixIxPresence(long), preserving the plain asn= wire shape (and any subclass behaviour) for that case. Multi-ASN calls require loadEquinixCatalog() to have been called first.

      Throws:
      IOException - if any API call fails
      IllegalStateException - if the Equinix catalog has not been loaded

    • close

      public void close()
      Closes the underlying HTTP client. Quiet by design: a close failure releases nothing actionable to the caller, and the analysis result it would otherwise mask is already in hand. Safe to call more than once. Ownership: whoever constructed this client closes it — the analysis engine never closes a client it was handed.
      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
